author: CreeperJoe62
body:
Oh no! You and your friends have trod on grandpa's flowers. Now he's angry!

In this game you are in a small circular arena where there is one grandpa (who has slowness 1) who will try to knock the other people out of the world (when a player is knocked out of the world grandpa gets an energy burst and gets speed 2 for 5 seconds). The players aim is to survive 5 minutes without being knocked out of the world. Every 30 seconds the children survive they gain 5 xp. Everytime the grandpa knocks a player out of the world he gains 3 xp as well as speed 2 for 5 seconds. The game will be 16 players (1 grandpa and 15 children). 


Tell me what you think :)
